sample_unit: AI-generated exercise programs (identical prompts in Ukrainian and English across three chatbots)

links.outcome: Guideline alignment and clinical depth of AI-generated CKD exercise programs by query language
links.effect: Ukrainian-language outputs were simpler, wellness-focused, with limited progression and monitoring; English-language outputs were more detailed, guideline-aligned, with structured progression and validated monitoring tools.
links.quote: English-language prompts produced more detailed and guideline-aligned outputs, whereas Ukrainian-language prompts generated simpler, wellness-oriented recommendations.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates LLMs for generating clinical CKD exercise plans, specifically testing how query language (English vs. Ukrainian) impacts output quality, guideline alignment, and clinical safety.

primary.practice: multilingual prompt translation check / language equity evaluation
